segments.caption: A large passenger airplane descends for landing against a hazy, golden sky, its approach framed by an airport runway stretching toward a distant city skyline, with lush green trees in the foreground.
An airplane descends steadily toward a runway during a hazy, golden-hour sunset, its landing gear deployed as it approaches for touchdown, with distant city buildings visible on the horizon.

A large passenger jet descends steadily for landing, its landing lights glowing brightly against the hazy, golden-orange sky of either sunrise or sunset. The aircraft is captured in a head-on approach, flying low over a long, dark runway marked with white lines, with a line of green trees and distant city buildings visible on the horizon.
An airplane approaches on a runway during a hazy, golden-hour sunset, its landing gear down and lights illuminated as it prepares to touch down, with distant city buildings visible on the horizon.

A large passenger jet, viewed from the front, steadily accelerates down the runway at an airport during a hazy, golden-hour sunset. Its landing lights are illuminated, and a faint plume of dust or exhaust trails behind it as it gains speed, preparing for takeoff. The scene is framed by green trees in the foreground and a distant city skyline under a warm, orange sky.

A large, four-engine passenger jet taxis steadily toward the camera along a runway at dusk, its landing lights glowing brightly against the warm, orange-hued sky. The aircraft, viewed from a distance through a foreground of trees, moves directly toward the viewer, with a distant treeline and city buildings silhouetted on the horizon.

A massive four-engine passenger jet, viewed from the front, steadily rolls down the runway toward the camera during a hazy, golden-hour sunset. The aircraft’s landing lights are on, illuminating its path as it prepares for takeoff, with a distant city skyline visible on the horizon behind a line of trees.

A large, white Boeing 747, identifiable as Air Force One by its markings, taxis down the runway at an airport during a hazy, golden-hour sunset. The aircraft, with "UNITED STATES OF AMERICA" written along its fuselage and the American flag on its tail, moves steadily from the center of the frame toward the right, eventually exiting the view as it continues along the tarmac.
